title: Seasonal tire change offer
description: Promote a winter or summer tire change with a discount via WhatsApp. Marketing template for tire shops and workshops. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Seasonal offers perform when sent before the first cold snap. Use a coupon code to track redemptions.

body.text: Winter is coming, {{first_name}}! Switch to winter tires before {{deadline}} and get *{{discount}} off* installation and balancing at Acme Auto.
